entry.name: array.unshift
entry.digest: Add one or more elements to the beginning of an array
entry.description: The base array is sent to the right inlet, which clears any elements send to the left inlet. Additional elements are sent to the left inlet, and can be repeatedly placed at the front of the output array, without the user needing to update the array in the right inlet. Unlike the JavaScript implementation, the input array is not changed in place.

attributes.name: wrapmode
attributes.digest: Wrap elements in array
attributes.description: When enabled, elements arriving at the left inlet will be wrapped in an array before being unshifted. By default, elements are unshifted unwrapped.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: In the left inlet, the list will be added to the beginning of the base array and the result will be output. In the right inlet, convert an incoming list to an array and replace the base array.

messages.name: array
messages.description: In the left inlet, the array will be added to the beginning of the base array and the result will be output. In the right inlet, replace the base array with the incoming array.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Reprocess previously received array and trigger output.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Reset the internal state of the object.
messages.description: All internal arrays will be cleared.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.description: In the left inlet, the dictionary will be added to the beginning of the base array and the result will be output. In the right inlet, wrap the dictionary in an array, and replace the base array.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In the left inlet, the floating-point value will be added to the beginning of the base array and the result will be output. In the right inlet, convert an incoming floating-point value to an array and replace the base array.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In the left inlet, the integer value will be added to the beginning of the base array and the result will be output. In the right inlet, convert an incoming integer to an array and replace the base array.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In the left inlet, the list will be added to the beginning of the base array and the result will be output. In the right inlet, convert an incoming list to an array and replace the base array.
